newsitem.title: USA: BET,G-III form black apparel venture.
newsitem.headline: BET,G-III form black apparel venture.

text.p: BET Holdings, Inc. and G-III Apparel Group Ltd. Monday announced a joint venture to produce BET-brand clothing and accessories for blacks and urban consumers.
BET-brand Outerwear, sportswear and accessories are slated to be shipped to selected national markets by the end of 1997, with national distribution scheduled in 1998, BET said.
"This joint venture promises to be an important strategic relationship for G-III and BET," G-III President and Chief Executive Officer Morris Goldfarb said in a statement.

G-III Apparel manufactures and distributes outerwear under its name and for several other labels. BET is an entertainment company whose core business is Black Entertainment Television, a cable television channel that caters to blacks.
